opportunities.name: Research paper lookup and note (arXiv → Semantic Scholar → notes)
opportunities.description: Search arXiv advanced search for a topic restricted to a specific year, open the top result, look up its title on Semantic Scholar for author and citation count, then save a summary note.
steps: Open arXiv Search > Advanced search
Type the topic in the search term box
Tick the date filter checkbox, choose specific year and enter the year
Click Search and open the first result
Copy the paper title
Search the title on Semantic Scholar and open the result
Read first author and citation count
Add a note: '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <author>, <n> citations'

opportunities.name: Case law lookup with statute and note (CourtListener → Cornell LII → notes)
opportunities.description: Search a Supreme Court case on CourtListener, read its citation and decision date, look up the related U.S. Code section on Cornell LII, and save a note.
steps: On CourtListener go to Case Law > Search Case Law
Enter the case name and press Enter
Open the matching case and read citation and decision date
On Cornell LII search the statute citation and open the section
Add a note: '<case>: <cite>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<title>)'

opportunities.name: Peerspace venue search
opportunities.description: Search Peerspace for venues by entering an activity and selecting a city from the autocomplete, then clicking Search.
steps: Click the activity field, select all, type the activity
Click the location field, select all, type the city
Choose the matching autocomplete option
Click Search

steps: Click the Search box, select all
